panels.description: Lina places the worn bronze Maker's Seal in Alex's palm. Their hands and the open-hand symbol dominate; leave upper space for her balloon.
Lina, Suri, Jalen, Ren and Alex touch the registry entry as Alex sets down the Seal. Keep hands, Seal and purifier visible; leave upper area for the sound effect.
The registry screen visibly lists all five named contributors in a large, uncluttered field, with the claim status on a separate line below. Leave the screen unobstructed for lettering.
Suri opens the public-release field and Ren presses it while the other three makers watch. Leave upper space for the final record.

items.speaker: LINA
items.text: It records who made this. It doesn’t make you owner of us.
